name: Quo
description: Quo (formerly OpenPhone) lets agents read calls, texts, call transcripts, and contacts in the signed-in user's Quo workspace, and send messages. Each user signs in to their own Quo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize the calls I missed yesterday.
What did the customer say in my last call with Jordan?
Draft a text reply to the newest unread message.

apps.name: Quo
apps.description: Calls, messages, transcripts, and contacts, over Quo's MCP server with browser sign-in.
